summary: Asset Trust & Provenance implemented on top of the existing media-asset pipeline (plan 02 VP7 kernel). Added QUARANTINED lifecycle state (fail-closed promotion requires a fresh human review record; metadata alone never auto-approves an UNKNOWN/proprietary license), full provenance fields for generated assets (tool/model/prompt_hash/seed/generation_receipt), commercial-use + trademark/attribution trust gates, static embedded-content scanning (never auto-runs script/driver/add-on; archive path-traversal blocked), and conversion lineage (derived asset -> source content hash + normalization receipt). Added 19 focused tests covering the plan's negative-test matrix (quarantine fail-closed, unknown-license-not-approved-by-metadata, checksum/commercial queries, embedded script + zip-bomb + add-on + zip-slip rejected, generated provenance, conversion lineage, content change -> new hash, signed-URL/token redaction).
